column1: # Parity edges, coverage-driven: every row here was added to close a
# measured statement-coverage gap in one or both engines (see
# docs/test-coverage.md), and every expectation was probed
# byte-identical in BOTH engines before pinning — the same promotion
# protocol as every other file here. Rows are grouped by the engine
# Exact numeric comparison and constraint meets: same-point tower
# ties in both directions, negative integral gaps, cross-leaf scale
# References and variables: numeric segments, relative misses, $vars
# of every bound kind, self-prefix cycles, path().
# The + operator across kinds, and unary minus refusals.
# String canon escapes and number rendering forms.
# Lists: closed with residue, null elements, spread canon, and a
# Expectations: escape with extra peer keys; a top expectation.
# Functions: exact-leaf rounding, string case, invalid args, move,
# Batch 2: reference modes ($SELF/$PARENT/$KEY, var path parts,
# numeric segments, dotted parents), function edges, closed bags,
# list spreads, junction dedup, + operator kinds, and neq edges.
# Batch 3: number-lexer edges (based literals, overflow, exactness
# windows), grammar dives, empty bags, and canonical keys.
# Batch 4: marked refs, zero-arg functions, pending-op meets,
# pref folding ranks, list spread merges, expect re-meets, and
# Batch 5: variable path parts of every scalar kind, chase edges,
# spread templates with path funcs in nested shapes, optional
# subtrees, pending-func meets, pref ranks, and key escapes.
